caribbean.headline: Barbados Faces Heavy Rain, Moderate Winds Today
caribbean.paragraph: Barbados is forecasted to experience 62% rain probability, with maximum sustained winds of 15 kt and waves up to 4.6 ft, dominated by an eastward swell with a 7 second period. Roatan will see 21 kt winds, triggering a small craft advisory for vessels in the area.

mediterranean.headline: Dubrovnik 100% Rain, Calm Winds, 4.0 ft Waves
mediterranean.paragraph: Dubrovnik is experiencing 100% rain probability, calm winds of 0 kt and a 4.0 ft wave height. I note that Marseille is facing 18 kt winds.
